reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with webshop orders
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE store_code = 'WEB-01'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY order_month
)
SELECT month, revenue_eur,
  SUM(revenue_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ytd_revenue_eur
FROM monthly

WITH monthly AS (

  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales

WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with webshop orders
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE store_code = 'WEB-01'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY order_month
)
SELECT m.month, m.revenue_eur, SUM(e.revenue_eur) AS ytd_revenue_eur
FROM monthly m
JOIN monthly e ON e.month <= m.month
GROUP BY m.month, m.revenue_eur
